python -c "
from semver import VersionInfo

# Test basic iteration
v = VersionInfo(1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build')
values = list(v)
print('Iteration result:', values)
assert values == [1, 2, 3, 'alpha', 'build'], f'Expected [1, 2, 3, \"alpha\", \"build\"], got {values}'

# Test unpacking
major, minor, patch, prerelease, build = v
print(f'unpacked: major={major}, minor={minor}, patch={patch}, prerelease={prerelease}, build={build}')

# Test version without prerelease and build
v2 = VersionInfo(1, 0, 0)
values2 = list(v2)
print('Without prerelease/build:', values2)
assert values2 == [1, 0, 0, None, None], f'Expected [1, 0, 0, None, None], got {values2}'

print('All tests passed!')
"
